0022600005.text: Both the Los Angeles Lakers and Golden State Warriors open their 2026-27 seasons, with the Lakers hosting. The Lakers are listed as day-to-day with game-time decisions for Adou Thiero, Cameron Carr, Collin Sexton, and Jarred Vanderbilt, while the Warriors are without Jimmy Butler III, Kristaps Porzingis, and Moses Moody, and Stephen Curry is day-to-day with an ankle sprain and also a game-time decision. The Lakers won the 2025-26 season series 3-1 and beat the Warriors 119-103 in their last meeting, on April 9, 2026, in San Francisco, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives the Lakers a 65% chance to win.
